purpose: Teach: 磯/黒髪/アジサイ/めがね/山菜/乳製品/谷間/偉人

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが磯釣りのお話してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was telling me about going shore fishing.
lines.style: Warm, almost dreamy tone. A mother sharing something she found charming about her husband. Gentle pacing, as if remembering the moment. Soft landing on the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの黒髪きれいだよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma's black hair is so pretty.
lines.style: Genuine, unguarded observation. A child's matter-of-fact sincerity, no performance. Soft voice, like he's thinking out loud. Brief and authentic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭にアジサイを植えましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's plant some hydrangeas in the garden, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle invitation. A mother's voice imagining something together with her child. Slightly conspiratorial—this is their thing. Warm and unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しいめがね欲しい
lines.style: Direct, small-voiced request. Not demanding—careful. The hesitation of a child wanting something but uncertain how to ask. Quiet but clear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが山菜を取りに行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather went out to gather mountain vegetables.
lines.style: Sharing family news with fondness. Reflective, as if picturing him in the mountains. Steady rhythm. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、乳製品入りの料理大好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I really love food with dairy in it.
lines.style: Enthusiastic but genuine. A child stating a preference with simple joy. Bright but not performative. Natural, unforced energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが谷間の旅館の写真を見せてくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father showed me photos from an inn in the valley.
lines.style: Sharing a small family moment. Wistful, as if she's visualizing the place. Moderate pace, grounded. Ends with quiet interest.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが偉人の伝記を読んで下さったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad read me a biography of a great person.
lines.style: Pride softly in the voice. A child sharing something that made him feel included and special. Earnest, genuine, no exaggeration. Small but secure.
